spec.rawSql:
WITH target_instrument AS (
  SELECT id, name
  FROM instruments
  WHERE id IN ($instrument)
)

SELECT
  o.start_time AS time,
  o.end_time AS timeEnd,
  t.name || ' OFF' AS title,
  'TEM server offline' AS text
FROM em_off o
JOIN target_instrument t
  ON o.instrument_id = t.id

spec.title: TD pickup position deviation on CLS
spec.description: Deviation of the last measurement from the median of the last 10 values. 11200 steps is 1mm

spec.rawSql:
WITH motor_position AS (
  SELECT p.param_id, ev.value AS pickup_value
  FROM parameters p
  JOIN enum_values ev ON ev.enum_id = p.enum_id
  WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND p.component = 'Motors'
    AND p.param_name = 'TDOnCLSMotorPosition'
    AND ev.member_name = 'Pickup_Cooling'
),
encoder_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'Motors'
    AND param_name = 'MtdRawEncoderPosition'
),
pickup_events AS (
  SELECT d.time
  FROM data d
  JOIN motor_position mp ON d.param_id = mp.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
    AND d.value_num = mp.pickup_value
),
encoder_data AS (
  SELECT d.time, d.value_num
  FROM data d
  JOIN encoder_param ep ON d.param_id = ep.param_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d.time)
),
encoder_at_pickup AS (SELECT
  e.time AS pickup_cooling_time,
  ed.time AS encoder_time,
  ed.value_num AS encoder_value
FROM pickup_events e
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ed.time, ed.value_num
  FROM encoder_data ed
  WHERE ed.time < e.time
  ORDER BY ed.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) ed ON TRUE
ORDER BY e.time DESC
LIMIT 10
),
median_last_10 AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY encoder_value) AS encoder_median
  FROM encoder_at_pickup
),
last_pickup AS (
  SELECT encoder_value AS last_encoder_value
  FROM encoder_at_pickup
  ORDER BY pickup_cooling_time DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (last_pickup.last_encoder_value - median_last_10.encoder_median) AS deviation
FROM last_pickup
CROSS JOIN median_last_10;

WITH matching_params AS (
  SELECT param_id, display_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name IN ('PIRsucCLSPressure', 'PIRchGaugePressure', 'PPgGaugePressure', 'PIRsucGatePressure')
    AND subsystem = 'SemiAutomatedLoader'
    AND component = 'Gauges'
)

  SELECT
   d.time,
   d.value_num,
   mp.display_name
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_params mp ON mp.param_id = d.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
ORDER BY d.time

WITH matching_params AS (
  SELECT param_id, display_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'Thermometer'
    AND param_name IN ('T_gripperTemperature', 'T_clbarTemperature', 'T_ColDewarTemperature')
)

SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '$__interval', d.time) AS time,
  p.display_name,
  AVG(d.value_num) AS temperature
FROM data d
JOIN matching_params p
  ON d.param_id = p.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND d.value_num != 0
GROUP BY time, p.display_name
ORDER BY time;

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'Process'
    AND param_name = 'CryoCycleDurationCLS'
),

value_data AS (
  SELECT
    d.time,
    d.value_num,
    LAG(d.value_num) OVER (ORDER BY d.time) AS prev_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
),

resets AS (
  SELECT time, prev_value
  FROM value_data
  WHERE value_num = 0
    AND prev_value IS NOT NULL
    AND prev_value > 0
)

SELECT AVG(prev_value) AS avg_max_before_reset
FROM resets;

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'LN2Sensors'
    AND param_name = 'LN2LevelGateState'
)

  SELECT
    d.time,
    d.value_num AS level
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)

spec.title: Temperature outliers
spec.description: Count any temperature outliers <70K or above 310K

spec.rawSql:
WITH matching_params AS (
  SELECT param_id, param_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'Thermometer'
    AND param_name IN ('T_gripperTemperature', 'T_clbarTemperature', 'T_ColDewarTemperature')
)

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Count",
  MAX(d.time) AS "Last outlier"
FROM data d
JOIN matching_params p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND (d.value_num < 70 OR d.value_num > 310);

spec.title: Sample loads since last cryo cycle

spec.rawSql:
WITH param_ids AS (
  SELECT param_name, param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'CryoCycleDurationMicroscope'
),

last_cryo AS (
  SELECT
    p.param_name,
    d.time AS cryo_end_time
  FROM param_ids p
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT time
    FROM data
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND param_id = p.param_id
      AND value_num <> 0
    ORDER BY time DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) d ON true
),

cassette_counter_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'SampleTransferCount'
),

baseline AS (
  SELECT d.value_num AS baseline_val
  FROM data d
  JOIN cassette_counter_param ccp ON d.param_id = ccp.param_id
  JOIN last_cryo lc ON true
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND d.time <= lc.cryo_end_time
  ORDER BY d.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

after_cryo AS (
  SELECT MAX(d.value_num) AS max_val
  FROM data d
  JOIN cassette_counter_param ccp ON d.param_id = ccp.param_id
  JOIN last_cryo lc ON true
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND d.time >= lc.cryo_end_time
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(a.max_val, b.baseline_val) - COALESCE(b.baseline_val, 0) AS sample_loads_since_cryocycle
FROM baseline b
CROSS JOIN after_cryo a;

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'LN2Sensor'
    AND param_name = 'SensorState'
)

  SELECT
    d.time,
    d.value_num AS level
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)

WITH matching_params AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name IN ('LoadingPhase', 'UnloadingPhase')
    AND subsystem = 'SemiAutomatedLoader'
    AND component = 'Process'
)

  SELECT
   time,
   value_num AS phase
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_params mp ON mp.param_id = d.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
ORDER BY d.time

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_name,
    param_id
  FROM
    parameters p
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name IN ('CompartmentStateCLS', 'CompartmentStateMicroscope')
)
SELECT
  v.time,
  p.param_name,
  v.value_num
FROM
  data v
  JOIN matching_param p ON v.param_id = p.param_id
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(v.time)
ORDER BY
  v.time

WITH error_param AS (
  SELECT p.param_id, ev.value AS error_value
  FROM parameters p
  JOIN enum_values ev ON ev.enum_id = p.enum_id
  WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND p.component = 'Motors'
    AND p.param_name = 'MtdState'
    AND ev.member_name = 'Error'
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS mtd_errors
FROM data d
JOIN error_param ep ON d.param_id = ep.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND d.value_num = ep.error_value;

WITH error_param AS (
  SELECT p.param_id, ev.value AS error_value
  FROM parameters p
  JOIN enum_values ev ON ev.enum_id = p.enum_id
  WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND p.component = 'Motors'
    AND p.param_name = 'McstState'
    AND ev.member_name = 'Error'
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS mcst_errors
FROM data d
JOIN error_param ep ON d.param_id = ep.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND d.value_num = ep.error_value;
